ModuleType.description:
Strongly-typed module type identifier.

Variant declaration order is load-bearing: `Ord` is derived, and
`ModuleGraph` orders nodes by `(ModuleType, instance)` to keep offline
renders bit-exact across calls. Reordering or inserting variants
changes the processing order for any voice graph that mixes the
affected types, which silently changes audio output for existing
patches. Append new variants at the end.

NormalizedValue.description:
A value normalized to the range [0.0, 1.0].

Used for:
- Knob positions
- Envelope levels
- Mix amounts
- Pulse width
- Any parameter where 0 = min and 1 = max

id.description: Unique ID for this note (for editing/selection).

instrument.description:
Sequencer instrument ID. Conventionally `0` when the note's `track`
binds the instrument — the track-level binding wins at playback. Set
to a non-zero value only when bypassing the track's instrument (rare).

NoteId.description:
Unique identifier for a note within a pattern.
Used for selection, undo/redo, and editing operations.

NotePositionMapping.description: How MIDI notes map to positions in the room.

oneOf.description: All voices use the global source position (spatial off per voice).
Note 0 at left wall, note 127 at right wall (X axis).
Note 0 at front wall, note 127 at back wall (Y axis).
Notes distributed in a circle around the room center.

notes.description: Detailed explanation of how the patch works.

canvas_size.description:
Canvas size hint for the rack view.
Used to restore the scroll area size when loading a patch.

effect_chain_order.description:
Effect chain processing order (module IDs as strings, in chain order).

When present, the engine restores the effect chain to match this order
on load. Empty means "use legacy behavior" — chain order is then
reconstructed from `patch.modules` order.

Pattern.description: A pattern containing notes and automation.

notes.description: All notes, sorted by start tick.

length_override.description:
Optional per-placement length override. When `None`, the placement
occupies exactly `pattern.length` ticks. When `Some(d)`, the
placement extends/clips to that length; the engine still walks the
pattern's note timeline up to `min(d, pattern.length)`.

PatternTick.description: Relative position within a pattern (0 = pattern start).

Position.description: 2D position in the rack view, serialized as `{"x": ..., "y": ...}`.

oneOf.description: Rectangular room with dimensions in meters.
Cylindrical room (pipeline/tunnel mode).
L-shaped room (two connected rectangles).
Spherical room — all dimensions equal to diameter.
Dome (half-sphere) — height = radius, width/length = diameter.
Open tube (no end caps) — cylindrical with no end reflections.

Number of rows in a pattern (1-65535).

Clamped to a minimum of 1 — a pattern always has at least one row.

Pitch offset in semitones.

1 semitone = 100 cents
12 semitones = 1 octave

For engine-level instrument identification, see `engine::instrument::InstrumentId`.

oneOf.description: Don't steal - ignore new notes when full.
Steal the oldest active voice.

Ticks per row in song tick units (960 PPQN).

Controls how many song ticks pass before advancing to the next row.
Default: 240 song ticks/row = 4 rows per quarter note (16th note resolution).
